comparison_source: commonwealth (Portfolio Accounting Performance delivery dated 2026-06-23, silver performance table, Month rows, TWR, mapped to custody accounts through the same delivery's crosswalk, status MATCHED)
denominator_grain: account-windows: one Commonwealth Month row (PerfNum, percent) per matched account with EndDate on or after 2026-06-01

class_definitions.WINDOW_ENDS_BEFORE_SOURCE_COVERAGE: the reported window ends before the source's first value partition: the source holds no value anywhere in it
class_definitions.WINDOW_STARTS_BEFORE_SOURCE_BASE: the reported window starts so early that its base day (the prior trading day) precedes the source's first value partition, so the source cannot compound the whole window; source_rows_in_window of trading_days_in_window days are held
class_definitions.ACCOUNT_NOT_HELD_IN_WINDOW: the window is inside the source's coverage but the account has no value row on some day of it
class_definitions.DAY_NOT_MEASURABLE_IN_WINDOW: every day is held but one is NOT_MEASURABLE (no positive prior value), so the link breaks
class_definitions.NO_TRADING_DAY_IN_WINDOW: the reported window holds no trading day
class_definitions.RETURN_DIFFERS_BEYOND_TOLERANCE: the window is fully compounded from MEASURED or LARGE_FLOW days and differs from the reported figure by more than the tolerance
